intended_object: An auxiliary comparison morphism, colim_i F_i(U) → (sheafification of the pointwise presheaf colimit)(U). It is an intermediate step in the proof that taking sections over a compact open preserves filtered colimits of sheaves (from the docstring and the module documentation).
explanation: The morphism has two parts. First, the inverse of `colimitObjIsoColimitCompEvaluation` identifies the colimit of the sections with the pointwise presheaf colimit evaluated at U. Second, the unit of sheafification is evaluated at U. The map is used only as a step in the proof. The next definition, `transportedExplicitSectionsComparison`, transports it to the chosen sheaf colimit, and the module documentation says the proof works by computing the sheaf colimit through this explicit sheafification model. It is not a standard mathematical object in its own right. It is an implementation detail of the proof that sections over compact opens commute with filtered colimits. Its construction is type-correct and does what its docstring says.
